Class UniqueFieldSpec<TEntity>

Namespace
HiveSync.Application.Specifications
Assembly
HiveSync.Application.dll

Specification to check whether a given string field value is unique within a set of entities. Supports optional scoping and ignoring a specific entity by ID.

public record UniqueFieldSpec<TEntity> : ISpecification<TEntity, bool>, IEquatable<UniqueFieldSpec<TEntity>> where TEntity : class, IBaseEntity
